content.text: Kotak Mahindra Prime Limited offers comprehensive financing solutions designed for automobile dealers across various manufacturers. With extensive experience in dealer financing across multiple automotive brands, KMPL supports dealers through customized funding solutions, quick turnaround times, and a single-window approach for their diverse financing needs. Our solutions are designed to help dealers manage inventory efficiently, expand operations, strengthen working capital, and drive business growth.

content.heading: Documents Required
content.subheading: Select employment type to update requirements

Type 1.title: Type 1
items: Brief background of promoters and details on existing business entities
Last 3 years audited financial statements of dealership and group companies.

Type 2.title: Type 2
items: Provisional Financials as may be required.
Financial Projections for next 5 years as may be required.
Project Report, details (in case of term loans
C.A certified net worth statements and ITRs of promoters

Type 3.title: Type 3
items: Current limits with banks / financiers with a copy of the sanction letter
Memorandum and Articles of association / Partnership deed
Any other information, declarations as may be required.
